name: May 20, 2025 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  MAY 20, 2025
  MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  6:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Skophammer called the meeting to order at 6:34 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Dane Skophammer, Vice Chair Alicia Peak, Commissioners Georgia
  Goldfarb (arrived at 6:35 p.m.), Jake Lingo, and Judy Villablanca

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Chris Orosz, Recreation
  Supervisor; and Brittany Saleaumua, Administrative Assistant

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chair Skophammer led the Pledge of Allegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Chair Skophammer moved, and Vice Chair Peak seconded a motion to approve the
  agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 4—0; Commissioner
  Goldfarb absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the agenda for the meeting was
  posted on May 16, 2025.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Rec Technologies, Inc. New Recreation Software System

  Community Services Director Riesgo introduced Molly Nelson from Rec
  Technologies, Inc.

  Molly Nelson presented the Rec Technologies, Inc. recreation software platform
  that would be launched in Fall 2025.
   Parks and Recreation Commission
  Rogular Meeting
  Minutes of May 20, 2025
  Page 2 of 4

  In response to Vice Chair Peak, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  Department will have a two—phase approach. Phase 1 would be recreation program
  registration and Phase 2 would be facility rentals.

  B.  Election of Chair and Vice Chair

  Chair Skophammer opened the floor for Chair nominations.

  Commissioner Goldfarb nominated Commissioner Villablanca for Chair.

  Chair Skophammer closed the floor for Chair nominations.

  The question was called, and the Commission unanimously voted in favor of
  Commissioner Villablanca as Chair.

  Chair Villablanca opened the floor for Vice Chair nominations.

  Vice Chair Peak nominated Commissioner Lingo for Vice Chair.

  Chair Villablanca closed the floor for Vice Chair nominations.

  The question was called, and the Commission unanimously voted in favor of
  Commissioner Lingo as Vice Chair.

ITEM 2  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Joe Sichta stated the Malibu Aquatics Foundation partnered with Class Aquatics,
  and the organization secured a corporate sponsor to help fund swim team training
  classes in Malibu. He stated classes would be offered to swimmers at a low price.

  Sue Murphree indicated support regarding the Malibu Aquatics Foundation and
  Class Aquatics providing swim team programs. She stated Malibu did not have a
  competitive swim program and the Request for Qualifications process should be
  reviewed.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Chair Villablanca moved, and Commissioner Skophammer seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried unanimously.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:
  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  l.  Community Services Department Monthly Report
   Parks and Recreation CommissiOn
  Regular Meeting

  Page 3 of 4

  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report of activities, events,
  proj ects, and programs coordinated by the Community Services Department
  in April 2025.
  2.  Commission Assignments
  Recommend the proposed assignments for Fiscal Year 2025-26 for City
  Council consideration.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Youth Sports Organizations Facility Use

  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report on youth sports organizations’
  annual registration and facility use data.

  Interim Recreation Manager Orosz presented the staff report.

  Vice Chair Peak inquired about creating a youth flag football league.

  Commissioner Lingo stated the Westlake Flag Football program allowed anyone to
  register for their program. He stated a group of Malibu students could form a team.
  The team could practice in Malibu and play games in Westlake against Conejo
  Valley teams.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Interim Recreation Manager Orosz provided an update on trail maintenance,
  Charmlee Wildemess Park hikes, and summer programs.

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on Senior Center
  programs, Equestrian Park, Skate Park, Snack Shack, Jake Kuredjian Citizenship
  Award, and Parks and Recreation month.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Vice Chair Lingo stated the gophers were an issue at Malibu Bluffs Park. He stated
  that Mr. Sichta had provided public comment for multiple months and requested a
  future agenda item on swim team registration.

  Commissioner Skophammer stated the Commission should review the Request for
  Qualifications (RFQ) process and not the outcome of the RFQ.
   Parks and Recreation Commission

  Page 4 of4

  In response to Chair Villablanca, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  City and Malibu Marlins had a three-year agreement. She stated the City could end
  the contract early, but it must be reviewed by the City Attomey.

  Commissioner Peak stated swim team registration should be reviewed and
  discussed.

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Commission agreed to agendize an item to review pool
  operations, swim team programming, and participation data from 201 8 to present.

  ln response to Commissioner Peak, Interim Recreation Manager Orosz stated
  Views FC rented City fields. He stated staff did not track participation for rental
  groups.

  Commissioner Peak expressed concerns about Malibu Bluffs Park parking on
  Malibu Little League Closing Day.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Pool Operations, Swim Team Programming, and Participation Data

ADJOURNMENT

  Chair Villablanca adjourned the meeting at 8: l 7 p.m.

  Approved and adopted by the Parks and
  Recreation Commission of the City of
  Malibu on August 19, 2025.

  J D  VILLAygLANCA. Chair
